Reuben_1: firstborn son of Jacob (Genesis 29:32), son of Leah
Simeon_1: second-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:33), son of Leah
Levi_1: third-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:34), son of Leah
Judah_1: fourth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:35), son of Leah
Dan_1: fifth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:5), son of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid
Naphtali_1: sixth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:7), son of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid
Gad_1: seventh-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:11, Genesis 35:26), son of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid
Asher_1: eighth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:11, Genesis 35:26), son of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid
Issachar_1: ninth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:17), son of Leah
Zebulun_1: tenth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:19), son of Leah
Joseph_1: eleventh-born son of Jacob and Rachel (Genesis 30:24)
Benjamin_1: twelfth-born son of Jacob and Rachel (Genesis 35:18)
Tamar_1: wife of Er (Genesis 38:6), and mother of Perez (Genesis 38:29) and Zerah (Genesis 38:30) by Judah
Hezron_2: son of Perez and grandson of Judah (Genesis 46:12)
Hamul_1: son of Perez and grandson of Judah (Genesis 46:12)
Nahshon_1: son of Amminadab and brother of Elisheba (Exodus 6:23), head of the tribe of Judah during the census (Numbers 1:7)
Hur_1: supported Moses' hands during the battle against Amalek at Rephidim (Exodus 17:10-12)
Bezalel_1: called by God in the construction of the tabernacle (Exodus 31:2)
Gilead_1: a son of Machir, grandson of Manasseh (Numbers 26:29)
Jair_1: captured the region of Argob and called it Havvoth-jair (Numbers 32:41)
Carmi_2: father of Achan, son of Zabdi from the tribe of Judah (Joshua 7:1)
Zabdi_1: father of Carmi, father of Achan who took forbidden things from Jericho (Joshua 7:1)
Boaz_1: kinsman of Naomi's husband (Ruth 2:1) who redeemed Ruth (Ruth 4:10)
Obed_1: son of Ruth and father of Jesse (Ruth 4:17)
David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Ram_1: son of Hezron in the lineage of King David (Ruth 4:19)
Salmon_1: son of Nahshon and father of Boaz in the lineage of King David (Ruth 4:19)
Eliab_3: firstborn (1 Chronicles 2:13) son of Jesse (1 Samuel 16:6) brother of David
Abinadab_2: second-born (1 Chronicles 2:13) son of Jesse (1 Samuel 16:8) brother of David
Shammah_2: third-born (1 Chronicles 2:13) son of Jesse (1 Samuel 16:9) brother of David
Abishai_1: son of Zeruiah and Joab's brother (1 Samuel 26:6), chief of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:18)
Zeruiah_1: mother of Abishai, Joab (1 Samuel 26:6), and Asahel (2 Samuel 2:18), sister of King David (1 Chronicles 2:16)
Joab_1: son of Zeruiah (2 Samuel 2:13), commander of David's army (1 Chronicles 27:34)
Asahel_1: brother of Joab and Abishai (2 Samuel 2:18), sixth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:24)
Amasa_1: set over David's army in place of Joab (2 Samuel 17:25)
Abigail_2: daughter of Nahash, sister of Zeruiah (2 Samuel 17:25), (half-?) sister of King David (1 Chronicles 2:16)
Heman_1: son of Zerah (1 Chronicles 2:6).  Solomon was wiser than him (1 Kings 4:31)
Calcol_1: son of Zerah (1 Chronicles 2:6).  Solomon was wiser than him (1 Kings 4:31)
Darda_1: son of Zerah (1 Chronicles 2:6).  Solomon was wiser than him (1 Kings 4:31)
Bath-shua_1: the Canaanitess, mother of Judah's first three sons (1 Chronicles 2:3)
Jerahmeel_1: son of Hezron, son of Perez (1 Chronicles 2:9)
Chelubai_1: son of Hezron, son of Perez (1 Chronicles 2:9)
Segub_2: son of Hezron (1 Chronicles 2:21), father of Jair_1 (1 Chronicles 2:22)
Abijah_3: wife of Hezron (1 Chronicles 2:24), daughter of Machir (1 Chronicles 2:21)
Onam_2: son of Jerahmeel and Atarah (1 Chronicles 2:26)
Maaz_1: son of Ram, son of Jerahmeel (1 Chronicles 2:27)
Jamin_2: son of Ram, son of Jerahmeel (1 Chronicles 2:27)
Eker_1: son of Ram, son of Jerahmeel (1 Chronicles 2:27)
Shammai_1: son of Onam, son of Jerahmeel (1 Chronicles 2:28)
Jada_1: son of Onam, son of Jerahmeel (1 Chronicles 2:28)
Haran_2: son of Chelubai [Caleb] by Ephah (1 Chronicles 2:46)
Moza_1: son of Chelubai [Caleb] by Ephah (1 Chronicles 2:46)
Gazez_1: son of Chelubai [Caleb] by Ephah (1 Chronicles 2:46)
Sheber_1: son of Chelubai [Caleb] by Maacah (1 Chronicles 2:48)
Tirhanah_1: son of Chelubai [Caleb] by Maacah (1 Chronicles 2:48)
Shaaph_2: son of Chelubai [Caleb] by Maacah (1 Chronicles 2:49)
Sheva_2: son of Chelubai [Caleb] by Maacah (1 Chronicles 2:49)
Shobal_2: son of Hur who founded Kiriath-jearim (1 Chronicles 2:50)
Salma_1: son of Hur who founded Bethlehem (1 Chronicles 2:51)
Hareph_1: son of Hur who founded Beth-gader (1 Chronicles 2:51)
